ios.desc:
Your adventures. Your data. Your rules. Now on iPhone Duo!

Every trip you've ever taken, in one place. Forever yours.

TravelTracker is the privacy-first trip journal, photo organizer, and vacation planner, all in one app. Track every country, park, and UNESCO site you've visited, beautifully organized and completely under your control. No ads. No tracking. Ever.

WHAT YOU CAN TRACK
 • 195+ countries and territories
 • All 50 US states and Canadian provinces
 • 400+ national parks worldwide
 • 1,000+ UNESCO World Heritage Sites
 • Geographic extreme points
 • Custom cities and locations
 • Your own photos and journal entries

KEY FEATURES

Trip Planner & Journal
Plan upcoming trips and capture the ones you've taken. Add dates, locations, lodging, journal entries, and photos. Weather context is added automatically so every memory stays authentic.

Photo Organization
Upload travel photos and tie them to the trip and journal entry where the memory was made, so years from now you can find it again in seconds. Browse in a full-screen lightbox, organized by trip or by place.

Interactive Maps
Watch your world fill in. Every country, state, park, and city you've visited, rendered on beautiful interactive maps. Zoom, filter by category, share the view.

Travel Statistics
Countries visited, distance traveled, parks checked off, continents explored, plus achievement badges for milestones along the way.

Bucket List & Trip Sharing
Build the bucket list of places you're still going to see. Share trips with secure links, or add co-owners so family and friends can contribute to shared adventures.

PRIVACY FIRST
We don't track you. No analytics, no third-party pixels, no data selling. Your trips and photos are yours alone. We make money from subscriptions, never from your data.

PRICING

Explorer (Free Forever)
 • Track up to 4 trips
 • 200MB photo storage
 • Full access to all curated location databases
 • Interactive maps and statistics
 • Trip sharing
 • 5 journal writing prompts

Adventurer (Paid Upgrade)
 • Everything in Explorer
 • Unlimited trips
 • Unlimited photo storage
 • 20+ premium journal prompts
 • Trip collaboration with co-owners

No credit card required. Upgrade anytime. Cancel anytime.

Terms of Use: https://traveltracker.me/terms
Privacy Policy: https://traveltracker.me/privacy

android.desc:
TravelTracker.me is your private travel diary, trip journal, vacation planner, and bucket list tracker. Whether you're road-tripping across national parks, exploring UNESCO World Heritage Sites, or tracking every country you've visited, TravelTracker.me is the travel app that helps you document and relive your adventures, your personal travel log for phone or tablet.

Privacy First:
Your travel data belongs to you. We don't use third-party trackers, advertising cookies, or analytics. We never sell your information or share it with advertisers. Photos are automatically scrubbed of hidden location metadata on upload. You can delete all your data anytime. And when you share a trip, you control who sees it and for how long. No ads. No tracking. Ever.

Your Travel Dashboard:
See your entire travel journey at a glance. Your dashboard shows total trips, photos captured, countries, and continents visited, and total distance traveled. Browse recent activity as cards or a timeline, and jump right into any trip.

Plan & Track Your Trips:
Create detailed trip itineraries with the built-in trip planner. Add dates, destinations, transport mode, and lodging. Log every hotel, Airbnb, or campsite along the way. Add visited locations with categories and country flags to build your personal travel map and see everywhere you've been. Great for vacation planning, road trip planning, and tracking places visited. TravelTracker.me is the trip tracker built for real travelers.

Write Your Travel Journal:
Capture the moments that matter. Write travel journal entries and travel log entries for each day of your trip, complete with weather data, lodging details, and photos. Your entries become a private travel diary and lasting travel memories you can revisit anytime, years from now.

Organize Your Photos:
Upload travel photos directly to your trips, journal entries, and lodging. Set a key photo for each trip and browse all your memories from within the trip itself. You can also view your entire photo collection organized by adventure in a dedicated gallery.

Explore Curated Collections:
Track your progress across bucket-list destinations:
- US National Parks, Battlefields, Parkways, Scenic Trails, and more
- UNESCO World Heritage Sites worldwide
- The New and Original 7 Wonders of the World
- Geographic extreme points

Search and filter locations by category, or toggle to see only the ones you've already visited.

quotes.text:
I'm working on TravelTracker, a travel journal that doesn't track you back.

I kept running into the same thing with every travel app I tried: they either wanted background GPS running 24/7, or they quietly turned my trip history into ad-targeting data. I wanted to remember where I'd been without handing that memory to an ad broker. So I built the thing I wanted.

No analytics, no pixels, no third-party tracking. You log trips manually (countries, national parks, UNESCO sites, cities, photos, journal entries), the data lives in one account that syncs across web, iOS, and Android, and the business model is a subscription, not your travel history.

Just shipped iOS today. Android went live last week, and the Web App has been live for a little while now.

Website: https://traveltracker.me

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/traveltracker-me/id6761914931

Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.traveltrackerme.app
